name: Grassy Terrain
effect: Target User's side of the field. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice to all Physical & Special Grass-Type Moves. Everyone on the User's side of the field heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will Point t activate. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: A patch of grass grows in the area surrounding the user, through it nature grants her many blessings.
